query_string: ("e-commerce" OR "online retail") AND ("return forecasting" OR "predicting returns") AND ("machine learning" OR "algorithms")
screening_notes: Identified Karl (2024/2025) systematic review (25 papers), Shang et al. basket-level models. High prior-art saturation in return probability prediction.

query_string: ("return fraud" OR "fraudulent returns" OR "wardrobing" OR "refund fraud") AND ("e-commerce" OR "retail")
screening_notes: Identified Johna et al. (2020), Shang et al. (2017), King & Dennis (2006), Bhattacharya (2026). Establishes fraud taxonomy and agent-level refund auditing.

query_string: ("Open Box Delivery" OR "doorstep inspection") AND ("India" OR "Flipkart" OR "Amazon")
screening_notes: Identified Flipkart OBD terms, legal analyses of OTP-coercion, and consumer dispute patterns under CPA 2019. Zero peer-reviewed field experiments exist on OBD error rates.

thematic_block: Block D: Reverse Logistics & Anomaly Detection
query_string: ("reverse logistics" OR "returns management") AND ("anomaly detection" OR "automated grading" OR "inspection")
screening_notes: Identified Elia et al. (2024) single-company case, Mishra & Dutta (2026) 240-paper review. Confirms return management is heavily studied, but handover continuity is acknowledged as an open gap.

query_string: ("product substitution" OR "item swap" OR "wrong item" OR "counterfeit return") AND ("e-commerce" OR "supply chain")
screening_notes: Identified studies on RFID/barcode item authentication, tamper-evident packaging, and computer-vision grading. Focuses on isolated sorting hubs, not continuous custody.

thematic_block: Block F: Chain of Custody & Telematics
query_string: ("chain of custody" OR "evidence provenance" OR "handover documentation") AND ("last-mile" OR "reverse logistics")
screening_notes: Identified IoT/telematics and blockchain digital product passport frameworks. Highlights broken audit trails between 3PL carriers and merchant receiving as an acknowledged industrial failure mode.

query_string: ("Consumer Protection Act" OR "Consumer Commission" OR "deficiency in service") AND ("wrong product" OR "unboxing video" OR "Open Box Delivery")
screening_notes: Extracted adjudicated DCDRC rulings: Mumbai (Rushabh Maroo v CrossBeats), Adilabad (Flipkart Qubo), Kurnool (Perfume 24x7), Rangareddy (Sunglasses return). Establishes legal standards on burden of proof.

query_string: ("National Consumer Helpline" OR "NCH" OR "Consumer Protection E-Commerce Rules") AND ("grievance" OR "amendment")
screening_notes: Extracted official 10 Sep 2026 PIB release (511,196 e-commerce grievances in 2025; ~29% of NCH) and Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Amendment Rules 2026 (commencing 1 Jan 2027).
